authors: Tak Wing Yu, Michael Rowe, Jose Frantz
title: Virtual Reality in Health Professions Education: Qualitative Descriptive Study of Educators’ Perspectives
summary: This qualitative descriptive study examines how educators view immersive virtual reality in health professions education. It argues that implementation depends on curriculum alignment, scaffolding, and institutional support rather than hardware alone.
apaAuthors: Yu, T. W., Rowe, M., & Frantz, J.

summaries.zh-hant: 此項質性描述研究探討健康專業教育工作者如何看待沉浸式虛擬實境。研究指出，成功實施有賴課程配合、學習支架與院校支援，而不只是硬件。
summaries.zh-hans: 此项质性描述研究探讨健康专业教育工作者如何看待沉浸式虚拟现实。研究指出，成功实施有赖课程衔接、学习支架与院校支持，而不只是硬件。

authors: Tak Wing Yu, Michael Rowe, Jose Frantz
title: virtual reality, higher education, learning outcomes, technology, teaching and learning.
summary: This preprint maps how virtual reality has been used in health professions education and where the evidence base remains thin. It highlights anatomy and clinical education as the main application areas, while also identifying questions of efficacy, learner experience, pedagogy, and cost.
apaAuthors: Yu, T. W., Rowe, M., & Frantz, J.

summaries.zh-hant: 此預印本整理虛擬實境在健康專業教育中的應用，以及現有證據的不足。研究指出解剖學與臨床教育是主要應用領域，並提出成效、學習者經驗、教學法及成本方面的問題。
summaries.zh-hans: 此预印本整理虚拟现实在健康专业教育中的应用，以及现有证据的不足。研究指出解剖学与临床教育是主要应用领域，并提出成效、学习者体验、教学法及成本方面的问题。

authors: Tak Wing Yu, Jose Frantz, Michael Rowe
title: Perceptions of health professions students on the use of immersive virtual reality
journal: African Journal of Health Professions Education
summary: A qualitative study of 18 health professions students explores their experience of immersive virtual reality. Students described engagement and potential for anatomy and clinical education, alongside technical and financial challenges. These are perceptions, not measured learning gains.

summaries.zh-hant: 這項質性研究探討18名健康專業學生使用沉浸式虛擬實境的經驗。學生描述投入程度，以及在解剖和臨床教育中的應用潛力，同時指出技術與財務挑戰。這些是學生觀感，並非經量度的學習成效。
summaries.zh-hans: 这项质性研究探讨18名健康专业学生使用沉浸式虚拟现实的经验。学生描述投入程度，以及在解剖和临床教育中的应用潜力，同时指出技术与财务挑战。这些是学生观感，并非经测量的学习成效。

apaAuthors: Yu, T. W., Frantz, J., & Rowe, M.

authors: Tak Wing Yu, Ghaleelullah Achmat, Luzaan Kock, Gareth Smithdorf
title: Exercise therapy education enriched through interprofessional teaching
summary: This short piece shows how exercise-therapy teaching can be strengthened through interprofessional learning. It points to collaboration across professional boundaries as a way to enrich educational experience and broaden students’ understanding of practice.
apaAuthors: Yu, T. W., Achmat, G., Kock, L., & Smithdorf, G.

summaries.zh-hant: 此短文說明跨專業學習如何豐富運動治療教學。文章指出，跨專業協作可改善學習經驗，並擴闊學生對實務的理解。
summaries.zh-hans: 此短文说明跨专业学习如何丰富运动治疗教学。文章指出，跨专业协作可改善学习体验，并拓宽学生对实践的理解。

title: Participation restrictions and vocational rehabilitation needs experienced by persons with a unilateral lower limb amputation in the Western Cape, South Africa
summary: This study examines participation restrictions and vocational-rehabilitation needs after unilateral lower-limb amputation in the Western Cape. It highlights major mobility barriers and argues for rehabilitation services that better support return to work and wider social participation.

summaries.zh-hant: 此研究探討南非西開普省單側下肢截肢人士面對的參與限制與職業復康需要。結果突顯重要的活動障礙，並倡議更能支援重返工作及社會參與的復康服務。
summaries.zh-hans: 此研究探讨南非西开普省单侧下肢截肢人士面对的参与限制与职业康复需要。结果凸显重要的活动障碍，并倡议更能支持重返工作及社会参与的康复服务。

authors: Tammy-Lee Williams, Blake Boggenpoel, Danelle Hess, Tania Steyl, Shamila Gamiet, Vuyolwethu Madasa, Tak Wing Yu, Nondwe Mlenzana, Farhana Karachi, Joliana Phillips
title: Exploring physiotherapy students’ clinical experiences during educational disruption, through a community of practice lens
summary: Interviews with nine final-year physiotherapy students examine clinical learning during pandemic disruption. A communities-of-practice perspective highlights departmental support, communication and mentorship.

summaries.zh-hant: 透過訪談九名物理治療應屆畢業生，探討疫情擾亂下的臨床學習。研究以實踐社群為視角，呈現學系支援、溝通及導師指導的重要性。
summaries.zh-hans: 通过访谈九名物理治疗应届毕业生，探讨疫情扰乱下的临床学习。研究以实践社群为视角，呈现学系支持、沟通及导师指导的重要性。

apaAuthors: Williams, T-L., Boggenpoel, B., Hess, D., Steyl, T., Gamiet, S., Madasa, V., Yu, T. W., Mlenzana, N., Karachi, F., & Phillips, J.
